mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_search_log (keyword, result_count, searcher_id, searched_at) VALUES (#{keyword}, #{resultCount}, #{searcherId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM knowledge_search_log WHERE result_count = 0 GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY search_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(searched_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN result_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hitCount FROM knowledge_search_log WHERE searched_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(searched_at) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT DATE(searched_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS searchCount, SUM(CASE WHEN result_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hitCount FROM knowledge_search_log WHERE searched_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(searched_at) ORDER BY statDate
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_search_log WHERE searched_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
